anomalies.description: A collision occurs between the dashcam vehicle and a large truck on the left, evidenced by sudden violent shaking, debris impact on the windshield, and the truck’s abrupt lateral movement into the lane.

A white SUV (appears to be a Lexus RX) enters the intersection from the left and collides with the dashcam vehicle, which is proceeding straight through the intersection. The impact occurs around frame f1 (16.5s), causing the SUV to rotate sharply rightward and come to rest angled across the lane by f2 (17.0s).

After the collision, a person exits the driver’s side of the white sedan (which was behind the SUV and stopped after the crash) at t=23.0s (f14) and approaches the rear of the white SUV. By t=23.5s (f15), the person is standing beside the SUV’s driver-side rear door, gesturing aggressively toward the SUV’s driver’s window; physical contact or escalation is not fully visible but the posture and proximity suggest an imminent or ongoing verbal/physical confrontation.

A dark-colored SUV (appears to be a Toyota RAV4) enters the intersection from the left and collides with a white sedan traveling straight across the intersection. The impact occurs near the center of the crosswalk, causing the white sedan to rotate sharply counter-clockwise.

A white sedan in the right lane abruptly swerves left across lane markings and collides with or near the front vehicle (camera car), causing visible impact disturbance and rapid deceleration; the white car then veers back right and continues, suggesting a sideswipe or rear-end contact.
